case.title: Windows SQLite handle cleanup
case.expected: Temporary database can be cleaned after use
case.actual: Initial six quality tests failed during cleanup with WinError32
case.rationale: sqlite context commits but does not close connection
case.hypothesis: Close connection in finally after transaction completion
case.acceptance_evidence: Current fixed engineering suite passed; local HTTP workflow completed
